roster_rule: All completed rounds at each immutable snapshot; initial review through round5, append subsequently closed planned rounds up to8 without changing analysis rules. Never treat incomplete rounds as zero outcomes.

analysis.prefix_score_scale_matched: H*D/N at alpha .12 with H48; preserves full-horizon penalty magnitude
analysis.D_length_regression: pooled and within-bank-demeaned OLS; descriptive, not proof of causal fall incentive
analysis.new_unique_rows: exact input-target row bytes versus previous and cumulative retained data, also new observation-only rows
analysis.fall_support: terminal fall boundary and last pre-action boundary; fixed original W2 normalization; current and cumulative actual training support; held set excluded
analysis.spectra: all300-control episodes primary; preserve episode boundaries. Welch nperseg300/noverlap150 needed because original450/225 does not fit300. Original burn100 sensitivity nperseg200/noverlap100; no temporal concatenation.
analysis.neighbour_bands: original distance-exclusion and whole-episode-held-out control; >=K finite neighbours required, fixed W2 normalization for comparison. Report missing/negative R2, do not apply admission gates.
